summary: Iteration 68 - Admin Mobile Tabs Bug Fix, Series Bulk Operations, Series Badge: All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified mobile admin dropdown (12 tabs), desktop scrollable tabs, series badge 'Serie X/Y' format, and SeriesManagerDialog with bulk edit/delete functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin mobile tabs correctly implemented: sm:hidden dropdown (<640px) + hidden sm:block scrollable tabs (>=640px)
Series enrichment in GET /api/meetings correctly calculates series_index and series_total by sorting occurrences chronologically
PATCH /api/meetings/series/{series_id} properly validates _BULK_ALLOWED_FIELDS whitelist and rejects disallowed fields silently
DELETE /api/meetings/series/{series_id} correctly cascades to meeting_participants and chat_messages collections
SeriesManagerDialog UI well-structured with occurrence list, 6 bulk toggles, scope radios, and action buttons
seed_data_creation: Test series meetings created during tests (cleaned up after each test)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 68 tested: (1) Admin/Verwaltung mobile tabs bug fix - mobile viewport (390x844) shows Select dropdown with data-testid='admin-tab-mobile-select' containing all 12 tabs (Statistiken, Nutzer, Gruppen, Design, Integrationen, Erinnerungen, Richtlinien, Rollen & Rechte, Presets, Auto-Regeln, News-Moderation, Audit-Log). Desktop viewport (>=640px) shows scrollable horizontal tabs. (2) GET /api/meetings returns series_index and series_total for meetings with series_id - verified with custom recurring meeting creating 4 occurrences showing indices 1-4. (3) PATCH /api/meetings/series/{series_id} bulk update - tested lobby_enabled, chat_enabled, reactions_enabled, recording_enabled, transcript_enabled, meeting_mode, title, description updates with scope='upcoming' and scope='all'. Disallowed fields (host_id, meeting_id, status) silently rejected. Returns 404 for unknown series, 400 for no valid fields, 403 for non-host without meetings.manage_others cap. (4) DELETE /api/meetings/series/{series_id}?scope=upcoming|all - removes meetings + participants + chat_messages. (5) Frontend series badge shows 'Serie X/Y' format on recurring meetings, clickable to open SeriesManagerDialog. (6) SeriesManagerDialog contains: occurrence list with dates/durations/status, 6 bulk toggles (Lobby, Gast-Zugang, Chat, Reaktionen, Aufnahme, Transkript), scope radios (Zukünftige/Alle), 'Serie löschen' button, 'Übernehmen' button. (7) Regression: iteration 67 features (custom recurring, sentiment with attachments, surveys mobile) all passing (19/19 tests).
